apps.name: Gika
apps.artist: Hangzhou Hu Di Shen Shan Technology Co., Ltd.
apps.desc:
Your time, clearly mapped

Build better days by seeing exactly where your hours go.

• Track anything, any way. Run count-up, countdown, or Pomodoro timers—or all three at once when you’re multitasking.
• One-tap labeling. Every session fits into Thrive, Balanced, or Limit—no messy tag soup.
• Daily timeline & Month calendar. Zoom in to a single day’s grid or zoom out to spot patterns across an entire month.
• Deep summaries & Insights. Instantly know how much time went to sleep, workouts, meditation, and your top three projects—by day, week, quarter, or year.
• Widgets & Live Activities. Start, pause, and glance at progress right from your Home Screen or Lock Screen.
• Four handcrafted themes. Match Gika to your mood—or your phone.

Gika Premium unlocks Pomodoro mode, the timeline grid, rich summaries, and more. Choose a monthly or yearly auto-renewing plan and help us keep the updates

apps.name: Wuhu - Generative Space
apps.artist: Hangzhou Hu Di Shen Shan Technology Co., Ltd.
apps.desc:
Wuhu is a self-hosted workspace where people and AI agents work together with documents, conversations, and live data. This app is Wuhu’s native client for Mac, iPhone, and iPad, connecting to a space server hosted by you or your team.

KEEP YOUR WORK TOGETHER
Browse your space's documents, follow links between ideas, and open live views of your team's work. Notes, plans, and results stay in the space instead of getting lost in separate conversations.

WORK WITH RESIDENT AGENTS
Talk to the agents in your space, give them tasks, and read their replies. Follow a task's progress and inspect the work it produces alongside the documents it uses.

YOUR SPACE, YOUR SERVER
Connect to a Wuhu server hosted by you or your team. Your space operator chooses the AI providers and tools available to its agents. The app is free; hosting and model-provider services are configured separately by the space o

apps.name: Arcroom
apps.artist: Hangzhou Hu Di Shen Shan Technology Co., Ltd.
apps.desc:
Arcroom keeps your movies and shows in libraries you own — on your Mac or your NAS — and plays them beautifully on every Apple screen.

Import once, play everywhere. When you add a video, Arcroom converts it into a streaming-friendly format, so playback starts instantly and scrubbing stays smooth — and iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV and Apple Vision Pro all play the same library natively. You can even start watching while the import is still running.

YOUR STORAGE, YOUR RULES
Libraries are plain folders on storage you control: this device, an SMB share on your NAS, or a library another Mac shares over WebDAV. No server software to install, no account to create.

MADE FOR EVERY SCREEN
One library, four platforms. Browse on your phone, pick up on the couch, continue on Vision Pro. Playback progress syncs privately through iCloud.

BEAUTIFUL METADATA
Match your files against TMDB for artwork,
